message.reasoning: The user wants to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "I want to order a custom bronze sculpture of a horse. What materials do I have?" Actually they say: "我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？" Wait, they specifically mention bronze? They say "馬的青銅雕塑" which means "a bronze horse sculpture". Then they ask "有哪些材料選擇？" meaning "What material options do I have?" That seems contradictory: they already said bronze. Maybe they want to know what other materials are available besides bronze? But the prompt says we can only use the two functions: painting_create_custom and sculpture_create_custom. We cannot provide additional info beyond the function calls. So we need to call the function sculpture_create_custom with item="horse", material=some choice. But the user didn't specify a material; they just asked about options. According to policy, we should not provide extra info beyond the function call. So we might need to respond with a function call to sculpture_create_custom. But we need to choose a material. The user didn't specify one. We could default to Bronze? But the user explicitly said "青銅雕塑" which is bronze. So we can set material="Bronze". The user also didn't specify size, so we can omit or let it default to 12. So we call sculpture_create_custom with item="horse", material="Bronze". That satisfies the request.
